description: Current listed rental prices for one GPU model across providers, cheapest first, in USD per GPU-hour, each with the time it was read and the GPU Economy page that links its source. Live quotes only.

gpu.description: GPU id (h100-sxm, h200, b200, rtx-4090) or a name ("H100 SXM", "RTX 4090").

limit.description: Rows to return, cheapest first; default 10.

market.description: Market to keep; default on_demand. "any" keeps spot, community, serverless and reserved too.

region.description: Rates listed in US or EU regions, plus rates that name no region (a provider's rate everywhere); default any.

name: gpu_prices

cite_as.description: How to cite this answer: GPU Economy, the page, the data date.
